blocks.text: Kingdom Animalia ko mote taur par neeche diye gaye phyla mein baanta jata hai. Har phylum mein in baaton par dhyan dein: symmetry (jism ka tawazun), embryo ki kitni tissue layers, body cavity (jism ki khaali jagah), digestive (hazme ka), circulatory (khoon chalane ka), excretory (fuzla nikalne ka) aur nervous system, aur reproduction. Exam mein aksar inhi ka muqabla (comparison) poochha jata hai.

blocks.title: Woh alfaaz jo har phylum mein aate hain
blocks.text: Diploblastic: jism embryo ki do layers, ectoderm aur endoderm, se banta hai. Triploblastic: teen layers, jin ke darmiyan mesoderm hota hai. Acoelomate: body cavity nahi hoti. Pseudocoelomate: jhooti (false) body cavity, jo poori tarah mesoderm se ghiri nahi hoti. Coelomate: asal coelom, jo chaaron taraf se mesoderm se ghira hota hai. Protostome aur deuterostome coelomates ke do groups hain; farq is baat ka hai ke embryo mein mouth kaise banta hai.

blocks.alt: Keere jaise jism ke teen cross-sections. Acoelomate: gut aur body wall ke darmiyan ki jagah tissue se bhari hai. Pseudocoelomate: gut aur body wall ke darmiyan fluid se bhari cavity hai, jis par mesoderm sirf bahar ki taraf hai. Coelomate: cavity dono taraf se mesoderm se ghiri hai aur gut us mein latka hua hai.
blocks.caption: Acoelomate, pseudocoelomate aur coelomate body plans (asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Har section mein bahar wala halqa body wall hai aur andar wala halqa gut. Flatworms acoelomate hain: parenchyma jagah bharta hai. Roundworms pseudocoelomate hain: cavity fluid se bhari hai lekin gut ko seedha chhooti hai. Molluscs, annelids, arthropods, echinoderms aur chordates coelomate hain: mesoderm body wall aur gut dono par hota hai.

blocks.text: 1- Phylum Porifera

Is phylum mein sponges aate hain. Zyada tar marine (samandari) hain, kuch meethe paani (freshwater) mein rehte hain. Leucosolenia aur Euplectella (Venus' flower basket) samandari sponges hain; Spongilla meethe paani ka aam sponge hai.
Bazaar ka (commercial) sponge is tarah banta hai: sponge ko sukha kar, koot kar aur dho kar us ke tamam cells nikal diye jate hain; sirf skeleton bachta hai.

Sponges mein tissue level organization nahi hoti, yani cells mil kar asal tissues nahi banate. Zyada tar sponges asymmetrical (be-tarteeb shakal) hain, kuch mein radial symmetry hoti hai. In mein nervous system nahi hota. Body wall mein bohat se chhote soorakh hote hain jinhein ostia kehte hain; inhi se paani jism mein daakhil hota hai. Bara soorakh jis se paani bahar nikalta hai osculum kehlata hai. Jism ki bahar wali layer patle, chapte cells ki hoti hai jinhein pinacocytes kehte hain. Doosri layer jelly jaisi hai aur mesohyle kehlati hai; is mein amoeboid cells hote hain. Teesri layer, jo andar ki khaali jagah (spongocoel) ko line karti hai, choanocytes ya collar cells ki hoti hai. Skeleton calcium carbonate ya silica ki bareek sooiyon (spicules) ki shakal mein hota hai. Zyada tar sponges budding ya regeneration se asexual reproduction karte hain. Kuch sponges mazboot capsules banate hain jinhein gemmules kehte hain. Jab parent sponge mar jata hai to gemmules aazad ho jate hain; achhe mahol (favourable environment) mein gemmules se amoeboid cells bahar aa kar naya sponge bana lete hain.

blocks.alt: Sponge ki aam banawat. Daayen: guldaan (vase) jaisa sponge kat kar dikhaya gaya; deewar cells ki hai aur andar spongocoel ke gird choanocytes ki tah hai; paani deewar ke ostia se andar aa kar upar osculum se bahar jata hai. Baayen: deewar ka bara kiya hua tukra: bahar pinacocytes, beech mein mesohyle (amoeboid cells aur spicule ke saath), andar choanocytes; beech se ek ostium guzarta hai. Neeche: ek choanocyte, collar aur flagellum ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.9: Sponges ki numainda misaalein aur aam banawat (kitab ki Figure 1.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; sirf aam banawat).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Hare teer paani ka raasta dikhate hain: paani deewar ke chhote soorakhon (ostia) se andar aata hai, beech ki khaali jagah (spongocoel) mein jata hai aur upar ke bare soorakh (osculum) se bahar nikalta hai. Is bahao ko choanocytes (collar cells) apne flagella hila kar chalate hain, aur collar paani se khurak ke zarre pakarta hai. Deewar ki teen tahein: bahar chapte pinacocytes, beech mein jelly jaisa mesohyle jis mein amoeboid cells aur sooi jaise spicules (skeleton) hain, aur andar choanocytes.

blocks.alt: Guldaan (vase) jaisa sponge, kaat kar dikhaya gaya take us ki deewar aur darmiyani cavity nazar aaye. Bahar ki satah par bohat se chhote soorakh (ostia); upar ka bara soorakh osculum; andar ki layer collar cells (choanocytes) ki hai jin par flagella hain; layers ke darmiyan jelly jaisa mesohyl hai jis mein amoeboid cells aur sooi jaise spicules hain. Teer dikhate hain ke paani ostia se andar aa kar osculum se bahar jata hai.
blocks.caption: Sponge ki aam banawat (Figure 1.9 ke mutabiq asal 3D model).
blocks.long_description: Paani body wall ke ostia se andar khincha jata hai, spongocoel ko dhaanpne wale choanocytes ke paas se guzarta hai, aur upar ke ek bare osculum se bahar nikalta hai. Bahar wali layer pinacocytes, darmiyan mein mesohyl (amoeboid cells aur spicules ke saath), aur andar wali layer choanocytes.

fallback.text: Sponge ka body plan: paani ostia se andar, choanocytes ke paas se, aur osculum se bahar.
fallback.alt: Kate hue sponge body plan ki rendered tasveer.

blocks.text: 2- Phylum Cnidaria

Taqreeban tamam cnidarians marine hain, agarche kuch meethe paani mein bhi milte hain, jaise hydra aur (kitab ke mutabiq) jellyfish. Zyada tar cnidarians colonial (basti bana kar rehne wale) hain, jaise obelia, corals aur sea fans. Zyada tar sessile hain, yani ek jagah jure rehte hain, jaise hydra, coral aur obelia. Kuch motile hain, yani harkat karte hain, jaise jellyfish.

Cnidarians radially symmetrical aur diploblastic hain: baalig jism mein do tissue layers hoti hain, epidermis aur gastrodermis, jo ba-tarteeb ectoderm aur endoderm se banti hain. In dono ke darmiyan jelly jaisi mesoglea hoti hai jis mein amoeboid cells hote hain jo ectoderm ya endoderm se aate hain. Cnidarians mein khaas cells hote hain jinhein cnidocytes kehte hain. Har cnidocyte mein ek khaas organelle, nematocyst, hota hai jo jism ki hifazat karta hai aur shikaar (prey) pakarta hai. Cnidarians mein ek band sire wali (blind-ending) cavity hoti hai jise gastrovascular cavity ya enteron kehte hain. Yeh sirf ek soorakh, mouth, se bahar khulti hai. Mouth hi anus ka kaam bhi karta hai, yani bina hazam hua maadda bhi isi se nikalta hai. Mouth ke gird lambe ubhaar hote hain jinhein tentacles kehte hain. Aisa digestive system jis mein khana andar aane aur fuzla bahar jaane ka ek hi rasta ho, sac-like (thaili jaisa) digestive system kehlata hai.
Corals colonial cnidarians hain. Yeh calcium carbonate ka sakht exoskeleton banate hain. Yahi skeleton jama ho kar coral islands aur coral reefs banata hai.

Nervous system body wall mein neurons ka ek jaal (network) hai; central nervous system (dimagh aur spinal cord) nahi hota. Cnidarians mein respiratory, excretory aur transport systems nahi hote. In ki do body forms hain: polyps aur medusae. Polyps cylinder (belan) jaise hote hain aur apne aboral sire (mouth se ulti taraf) se kisi satah (substrate) ke saath jure rehte hain; yeh asexual reproduction karte hain. Medusae chhatri jaise hote hain aur aazadi se tairte hain; yeh sexual reproduction karte hain.

blocks.alt: Cnidarians ki do jismani shaklein, lambai mein kati hui. Baayen: polyp, neeche se chattan se jura hua, upar mouth jis ke gird tentacles hain. Daayen: medusa, chhatri (bell) jaisa, kinare se tentacles latakte hain aur mouth neeche ki taraf beech mein hai. Dono mein bahar epidermis, darmiyan mesoglea aur andar gastrodermis hai jo gastrovascular cavity ko gherti hai.
blocks.caption: Polyp aur medusa: cnidarians ki do jismani shaklein (hamara samjhane wala khaaka; kitab mein yeh diagram nahi).
blocks.long_description: Dono shaklon mein ek hi soorakh, mouth, gastrovascular cavity mein khulta hai. Polyp mein mesoglea patli hai; medusa ki chhatri mein mesoglea moti jelly jaisi hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Polyp aur medusa ek hi banawat ki do shaklein hain. Polyp ko ulta kar dein to woh medusa jaisa lagta hai: polyp ka mouth upar hai aur woh ek jagah jura rehta hai, medusa ka mouth neeche hai aur woh tair kar chalta hai. Dono mein sirf do tissue layers hain, epidermis (neela) aur gastrodermis (hara); in ke darmiyan jelly jaisi mesoglea (peeli) hai. Khurak aur fuzla dono isi ek mouth se guzarte hain (sac-like digestive system).

blocks.alt: Cnidarians ki do body forms saath saath 3D model mein. Baayein polyp: ek seedha belan jo neeche se jura hai, aur upar mouth ke gird tentacles ka halqa. Daayein medusa: chhatri jaisi ghanti jis ka mouh neeche ki taraf hai, aur kinaron se tentacles latak rahe hain. Dono ko kaat kar do body layers aur darmiyani gastrovascular cavity dikhai gayi hai.
blocks.caption: Polyp aur medusa, cnidarians ki do body forms (asal 3D model).
blocks.long_description: Polyp ek sessile belan hai jis ka mouth aur tentacles upar ki taraf hote hain. Medusa wahi body plan ulta aur chapta kar ke azad tairne wali ghanti ban jata hai, jis ka mouth neeche ki taraf hota hai. Dono mein bahar epidermis, andar gastrodermis, darmiyan mein mesoglea aur ek gastrovascular cavity hoti hai.

fallback.text: Polyp: belan jaisa, jura hua, asexual. Medusa: chhatri jaisa, azad tairta, sexual.
fallback.alt: Polyp aur medusa ki rendered tasveer.

blocks.text: 3- Phylum Platyhelminthes

Inhein “flatworms” (chapte keere) kehte hain. In ka jism unsegmented, naram aur dorsoventrally compressed hota hai, yani upar se neeche chapta. Zyada tar free-living (aazad) hain, jaise planaria. Kuch insaanon aur doosre janwaron ke andar rehne wale parasites (endoparasites) hain, jaise liver fluke, tapeworm aur blood fluke.

Flatworms triploblastic hain, yani jism ke tissues embryo ki teen layers, ectoderm, mesoderm aur endoderm, se bante hain. Yeh acoelomates hain: body wall aur organs ke darmiyan ki jagah ek dheela connective tissue, parenchyma, bharta hai. In mein bilateral symmetry hai, yani waazeh baayan aur daayan hissa, aur dorsal (peeth) aur ventral (pait) ki taraf. In mein respiratory aur circulatory (transport) systems nahi hote. In mein nali jaisi protonephridia ka jaal hota hai jis ki bohat si shaakhein hain. Har shaakh ke sire par ek bulb jaisa cell hota hai jise flame cell kehte hain. Flame cells ke cilia hil kar aas paas ka fluid naliyon mein kheenchte hain. Naliyan fluid se fuzla chhaan kar body wall ke ek chhote soorakh, nephridiopore, se bahar nikal deti hain. In mein neurons ka jaal hota hai. Aage ke sire (head) mein cerebral ganglia hote hain, jo lambai mein chalne wali nerve cords se jure hote hain; yeh cords aar paar shaakhon (transverse branches) se aapas mein mili hoti hain. Zyada tar aazad flatworms ke aage do saada eyespots hote hain. Flatworms “fission” se asexual reproduction karte hain: janwar beech se sikur kar do tukron mein bat jata hai aur har tukra apna ghaib hissa dobara bana leta hai. Sexual reproduction karne wale flatworms hermaphrodites (bisexual) hain, yani ek hi janwar mein nar aur maada dono organs hote hain.
4- Phylum Nematoda

Yeh roundworms (gol keere) hain, jin ka jism lamba, keere jaisa (gol) aur dono siron par nokeela hota hai. Kuch roundworms paani aur mitti mein aazad rehte hain, jaise Caenorhabditis elegans. Bohat se parasites hain, jaise ascaris, hookworm, pinworm aur whipworm.
Pseudocoelomates saat phyla mein baante gaye hain. In phyla ko mila kar ek unit banti hai jise Aschelminths kehte hain. Phylum Nematoda is group ka numainda (representative) phylum hai.

Roundworms triploblastic, bilaterally symmetrical aur unsegmented hain. Yeh pseudocoelomates hain, kyunke in mein ek jhooti body cavity, pseudocoelom, hoti hai jo fluid se bhari hoti hai. In ka digestive system tube jaisa hai: ek alimentary canal jis ke do soorakh hain, aage mouth aur peeche anus. Parasitic roundworms ka digestive system saada (simplified) hota hai. Excretory system protonephridia aur do excretory canals se bana hai; yeh canals aage ke sire par mil kar ek canal banati hain, jo pait ki satah (ventral surface) par ek nephridiopore se bahar khulti hai. Jism mein neurons ka jaal hai; pharynx ke gird ek nerve ring hoti hai jo chaar lambi nerve cords se juri hoti hai. Honton (lips) par baal jaise ubhre hue sense organs hote hain jinhein sensory papillae kehte hain. In mein waazeh respiratory aur circulatory systems nahi hote. Yeh unisexual hain, yani nar nematodes mein testes aur maada nematodes mein ovaries hoti hain.

blocks.alt: Upar: teen roundworms ke khaake, Ascaris (lamba, S jaisa), pinworm (lipta hua) aur Trichinella (lipta hua); Ascaris se neeche aam banawat ki taraf teer. Neeche: roundworm, aage mouth, phir pharynx, pharynx ke gird nerve ring, neeche ki satah par nephridiopore aur reproductive pore, jism ke saath intestine aur dum ke qareeb anus.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.12: Roundworms ki numainda misaalein aur aam banawat (kitab ki Figure 1.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Roundworm ki nali jaisi digestive system ke do siray hain: aage mouth aur peeche anus. Mouth ke baad pharynx (jamni) aur phir lambi intestine (laal) hai. Pharynx ke gird neela chhalla nerve ring hai, jis se nerve cords nikalti hain. Excretory canal neeche ki satah par nephridiopore se khulti hai. Jism ke andar ki khaali jagah (pseudocoelom) mein fluid bhara hai.
5- Phylum Mollusca

Molluscs ka jism naram aur unsegmented hota hai. Yeh qudrati jagahon (natural habitats) mein door door tak milte hain. Kuch sirf paani mein rehte hain, jaise mussels, octopus aur oyster; baqi nam jagahon par, jaise land snail (zameeni ghonga).

Molluscs triploblastic aur bilaterally symmetrical hain, aur in mein asal (true) coelom hota hai. Coelomates mein yeh protostomes ke group mein aate hain. In ka jism teen hisson mein bata ja sakta hai: head (sar), visceral mass (jis mein hazme, fuzla nikalne aur reproduction ke organs hain) aur foot (paon), jo visceral mass se jura hota hai. Visceral mass ke gird ek epithelial ghilaaf hota hai jise mantle kehte hain, aur mantle aur visceral mass ke darmiyan ki jagah mantle cavity kehlati hai. Zyada tar molluscs mein mantle ki bahar wali satah calcium carbonate ka khol (calcareous shell) banati hai. Bivalvia ke siwa tamam molluscs mein ek ragadne wala, zubaan jaisa organ hota hai jise radula kehte hain. Cephalopods ke siwa sab mein open type blood circulatory system hota hai. Dil mein ek ventricle aur do auricles hote hain. Digestive system tube jaisa hai jis ke do soorakh hain: mouth aur anus. Excretory system joron mein naliyon (nephridia) se bana hai. Fuzla sinuses se jama ho kar dil ke gird coelom mein daala jata hai; nephridia isi coelom mein khulte hain. Un ke soorakhon ke gird bareek cilia hote hain jo fluid ko coelom se nephridia mein le jate hain. Nephridia fuzla mantle cavity mein chhorte hain, jahan se woh bahar nikal jata hai. Molluscs mein gases ka tabadla gills karti hain. Head, visceral mass aur foot mein ganglia ke teen jore hote hain jo nerve cords se aapas mein jure hain. Yeh muscular foot ki madad se chalte hain. Kuch molluscs sessile hain. Zyada tar molluscs unisexual hain.

blocks.title: Open circulatory system
blocks.text: Open-type system mein khoon naliyon (vessels) ke andar nahi rehta, balke seedha tissue ki khaali jagahon (sinuses) mein cells ko nehlata hai.

blocks.alt: Ghonghe (snail) jaise mollusc ki aam banawat, pehlu se: visceral mass par shell, shell ke neeche mantle, visceral mass mein stomach aur lipti hui intestine, coelom mein heart, shell ke kinare ke neeche gill aur anus, sar mein mouth aur radula, aur muscular foot mein jati nerve cords.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.13: Molluscs ki numainda misaalein aur aam banawat (kitab ki Figure 1.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; sirf aam banawat).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Mollusc ke jism ke teen hisse yahan saaf dikhte hain: aage sar (head) jis mein mouth aur khurachne wali zuban jaisi radula hai, neeche bara muscular foot jis se janwar chalta hai, aur upar visceral mass jis mein hazme ke organs hain. Visceral mass ko mantle dhaanpta hai aur mantle hi upar sakht shell banata hai. Heart ke gird ki chhoti khaali jagah coelom hai.
6- Phylum Annelida

Annelids ko aam taur par segmented worms (hisson mein bate keere) kehte hain. Yeh samandar mein (jaise nereis), meethe paani mein (jaise leech yani jonk) aur nam mitti mein (jaise earthworm yani kenchua) milte hain. Kuch annelids ectoparasites (jism ke bahar chipak kar rehne wale parasites) hain, jaise jonk.
Bahar se segments jism ki satah par chhote chhallon jaisi sikurnon se nazar aate hain (“Annelid” ka matlab hai “chhota chhalla”).

Jism aar paar bohat se ek jaise hisson mein bata hota hai jinhein segments kehte hain. Andar se segments ek doosre se cross walls (septa) ke zariye alag hote hain. Har segment ke apne circulatory, excretory aur neural hisse hote hain. Jism ki is qisam ki segmentation ko metameric segmentation kehte hain. Annelids bilaterally symmetrical aur triploblastic hain; yeh protostome coelomates hain. Annelids mein khaas hisse hote hain jinhein setae kehte hain: har segment ki ventral wall mein chitin ke sakht baal (bristles). Jonk mein setae nahi hote. Body wall par epidermis ki banai hui nam, acellular (cells ke baghair) cuticle hoti hai. Digestive system tube jaisa hai; digestive tube alag alag hisson mein bati hai aur har hisse ka apna kaam hai. Parasitic annelids ka digestive system saada hota hai.

blocks.alt: Kenchwe (earthworm) ki aam banawat: peechhe ka hissa poora, chhallon jaise segments, neeche setae aur sire par anus; aage ka hissa lambai mein khola gaya: septa coelom ko khanon mein baantte hain, mouth se digestive tube, us ke upar aur neeche blood vessels jo pseudohearts se jure hain, neeche nerve cord aur aage cerebral ganglion, aur har segment mein metanephridium.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.14: Annelids ki numainda misaalein aur aam banawat (kitab ki Figure 1.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; sirf aam banawat).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Andar ki khaali jagah coelom hai jise septa (deewarein) har segment mein alag khanon mein baant deti hain; isi liye har segment mein apna metanephridium (neeli lipti nali) hai. Khoon hamesha naliyon mein rehta hai (closed system): upar ki aur neeche ki blood vessel aage ke hisse mein paanch jore pseudohearts (laal chhalle) se juri hain, jo dhadak kar khoon chalate hain. Nerve cord neeche (ventral) hai aur aage cerebral ganglion se milti hai.

Excretory system cilia wale, funnel (qeef) jaise metanephridia se bana hai; har segment mein metanephridia ka ek jora hota hai. Circulatory system closed type hai: khoon hamesha blood vessels ke andar behta hai. In mein khaas dharakne wale blood vessels hote hain jinhein pseudohearts kehte hain. Zyada tar annelids ke khoon ke plasma mein respiratory pigment haemoglobin ghula hota hai. Gases ka tabadla jild (skin) se hota hai. Aage ke segment mein cerebral ganglion ya brain hota hai, jis se ek dohri (double), lambi ventral nerve cord nikalti hai jo har segment ko nerves deti hai; har segment mein ganglia bhi hote hain. Annelids mein tactile receptors (chhoone ko mehsoos karne wale), chemoreceptors (chemicals ko), balance receptors (tawazun ko) aur photoreceptors (roshni ko) hote hain. Kuch annelids mein lens wali achhi tarah bani aankhein bhi hoti hain. Zyada tar annelids hermaphrodite hain (jaise kenchua, jonk) aur kuch unisexual (jaise nereis).
7- Phylum Arthropoda

Is phylum mein kai qisam ke groups aate hain, jaise insects (keere makore), crustaceans, spiders (makriyan), scorpions (bichhoo) aur centipedes. Yeh har qisam ki jagah (habitat) mein milte hain. Zameen par rehne wale bohat se arthropods ur bhi sakte hain.
Arthropods tamam invertebrates mein sab se kamyab (successful) hain. Taqreeban 900,000 species, yani Zameen ki naam di gayi tamam species ka do-tihai (two thirds) hissa, arthropods hain.

Arthropods triploblastic, bilaterally symmetrical, protostome coelomates hain. In ka coelom chhota (reduced) hota hai aur sirf reproductive aur excretory systems ke gird hota hai. In ke jointed appendages (joron wale aaza) hote hain jo khaas kaamon ke liye badle hue hain, jaise daurna, rengna, tairna, shikaar pakarna, saans lena, reproduction wagaira. Mukhtalif arthropods mein mouth ke gird ke jointed appendages alag alag tarah badal kar mouth parts bante hain. Jism segmented hai. Kuch segments jur kar khaas hisse banate hain jinhein tagmata kehte hain: head, thorax aur abdomen. In ka exoskeleton ya cuticle body wall ki epidermis banati hai; yeh zyada tar chitin ka hota hai. Chhote (young) arthropods mein exoskeleton waqtan fawaqtan utarta hai. Utarne ke baad janwar tezi se barhta hai aur phir naya exoskeleton banata hai. Is amal ko ecdysis ya molting kehte hain.

In ka circulatory system open type hai. Zyada tar waqt khoon hemocoel mein behta hai, jo embryo ki ek cavity, blastocoel, se banta hai. Khoon berang hota hai kyunke is mein haemoglobin nahi hota; ise haemolymph kehte hain. Zyada tar arthropods ka respiratory system hawa ki naliyon se bana hai jinhein trachea kehte hain. Bari tracheal naliyan spiracles naam ke soorakhon se bahar khulti hain. Paani mein rehne wale arthropods gills se saans lete hain. Digestive system tube jaisa hai aur alimentary canal mukhtalif hisson mein bati hai. Excretory system Malpighian tubules par mushtamil hai: yeh patli naliyan hain jo alimentary canal se nikalti hain aur midgut aur hindgut ke jor par lagi hoti hain. Nitrogen wala fuzla (nitrogenous waste) uric acid ke thos crystals ki shakal mein nikalta hai. Central nervous system achhi tarah bana hai: head mein cerebral ganglia ke teen jure hue jore dimagh (brain) banate hain. Ek dohri ventral nerve cord hai jis mein har segment mein ventral ganglia hain, aur in ganglia se chhoti nerves nikalti hain. In mein achhi tarah bani compound eyes aur antennae hote hain. Yeh apni jagah (habitat) ke hisaab se tairte, rengte ya urte hain.
Arthropods unisexual hain.

blocks.alt: Tiddey (grasshopper) ki andar ki banawat, pehlu se, aur ek chhota khaana jo head, thorax aur abdomen dikhata hai. Sar par compound eye, antenna aur mouthparts; sar mein cerebral ganglia; thorax par wings; mouth se anus tak digestive tube; hind gut par Malpighian tubules; peeth ke saath tracheal tubes aur hearts wali blood vessel; neeche ventral ganglia wali nerve cord.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.15: Arthropods ki numainda misaalein aur aam banawat (kitab ki Figure 1.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; sirf aam banawat).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Arthropod ka nervous system neeche (ventral) hai: sar mein cerebral ganglia dimagh banate hain aur neeche ki nerve cord par har segment mein ventral ganglia hain. Dil (hearts) aur blood vessel upar peeth ki taraf hain; khoon zyada tar haemocoel mein khula behta hai (open system). Saans ke liye tracheal tubes hawa seedha cells tak le jati hain, aur Malpighian tubules fuzla nikalte hain.

Aham arthropods: insects (jaise machhar, titli, moth, bhir yani wasp, beetles, tidda yani grasshopper), kekre (crabs), lobsters, jheenga (prawn, shrimps), crayfish, makri (spider), tick, mite, bichhoo, centipedes aur millipedes.
8- Phylum Echinodermata

Yeh sirf samandar mein rehne wale janwar hain. Kuch biscuit ki tarah chapte hain (jaise cake urchin), kuch chhoti bazuon wale sitara numa (jaise sea star ya starfish), kuch gol (jaise sea urchin), kuch lambi bazuon wale sitara numa (jaise brittle star) aur kuch lambe (jaise sea cucumber).

Echinoderms triploblastic aur deuterostome coelomates hain. In ke larvae bilaterally symmetrical hote hain lekin baalig radial symmetry dikhate hain, jis mein jism ke hisse oral-aboral axis (mouth se ulti taraf tak ki line) ke gird paanch ya paanch ke multiple mein lage hote hain. In mein calcium wala endoskeleton hota hai jo plates ki shakal mein hai; in plates ko ossicles kehte hain. Yeh plates mesoderm se banti hain lekin jild se bahar bhi nikal kar kaante (spines) banati hain. In mein water-vascular system hota hai: coelom ke andar naliyon aur khaali jagahon ka system. Mouth ke gird ek ring canal hoti hai jo chhalni jaisi plate, madreporite, se bahar khulti hai. Ring canal se paanch (ya paanch ke multiple) radial canals nikalti hain. Har radial canal se bohat si lateral canals nikalti hain aur har lateral canal ek tube foot par khatam hoti hai. Tube feet water-vascular system ke hi hisse (extensions) hain. Tube feet phail kar kisi satah se chipak jate hain. Jab chipke hue tube feet se paani wapas kheencha jata hai to woh sikurte hain aur jism aage khinch jata hai. Digestive system tube jaisa hai: mouth se oesophagus, stomach, intestine aur rectum, aur rectum anus se bahar khulta hai.

Respiration aur excretion ke liye koi khaas organs nahi hote. Nervous system kamzor (poorly developed) hai: ek nerve net, ek nerve ring aur paanch (ya paanch ke multiple) radial nerves. Zyada tar sensory receptors jism ki satah aur tube feet par phaile hote hain. Asexual reproduction mein jism do hisson mein batta hai aur har hissa regeneration se apna baqi hissa bana leta hai. Echinoderms unisexual hain.

Bohat se echinoderms khoye hue hisse dobara bana (regenerate kar) lete hain. Kuch, khaas kar sea stars aur brittle stars, hamla hone par jism ke kuch hisse gira dete hain aur baad mein unhein dobara bana lete hain.

blocks.alt: Sea star (starfish) ki aam banawat, upar se: beech mein stomach, anus aur ring canal; upar ki satah par madreporite jo ring canal se jura hai. Paanchon bazuon mein radial canal aur bazuon ke kinaron par tube feet; do bazuon mein digestive tube ki shaakhein. Gol khaane mein ek tube foot aur us ka bulb jaisa ampulla.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.16: Echinoderms ki numainda misaalein aur aam banawat (kitab ki Figure 1.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; madreporite ke sahih hijje).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Water-vascular system mein paani madreporite (chhalni jaisi plate) se andar aata hai, ring canal (mouth ke gird chhalla) mein jata hai, phir har bazu ki radial canal mein aur wahan se tube feet tak. Har tube foot ke upar ek bulb, ampulla, hota hai: ampulla sikurta hai to paani tube foot mein jata hai aur foot phail kar cheez se chipak jata hai.

10- Phylum Chordata

blocks.title: Kitab ki numbering
blocks.text: Kitab phyla ko 1 se 8 tak number deti hai aur phir Chordata ko 10 likhti hai; number 9 ka koi phylum chhapa nahi. Koi phylum chhoota nahi, sirf number chhoot gaya hai: Chordata is topic ka nawan (9th) phylum hai.

Chordates bilaterally symmetrical, triploblastic, deuterostome coelomates hain. Neeche di gayi chaar khasoosiyat sirf chordates mein hoti hain aur development ke kisi na kisi stage par zaroor maujood hoti hain.

items: Notochord: tamam chordates embryo ki zindagi mein notochord banate hain. Yeh vacuolated cells (khaali thailiyon wale cells) ki bani chhari jaisi, thori lachakdar (semi rigid) rod hai. Yeh gut aur dorsal nerve cord ke darmiyan jism ki poori lambai mein hoti hai. Neeche darje ke (lower) chordates isey poori zindagi rakhte hain, jabke vertebrates mein development ke dauran yeh thori ya poori vertebral column (reerh ki haddi) se badal jati hai.

Pharyngeal slits: yeh pharynx ki side walls mein soorakhon ki ek qataar hain. Tamam chordates embryo mein jore-daar gill slits banate hain. Kuch chordates mein (jaise Amphioxus aur machhliyan) yeh gills ban jate hain. Kuch mein (jaise zyada tar amphibians) yeh zindagi ke kuch arse kaam karte hain. Baqi mein (jaise reptiles, birds aur mammals) yeh doosre kaamon ke liye badal jate hain.
Tubular nerve cord: tamam chordates mein ek nali jaisi (tubular) nerve cord jism ki lambai mein, notochord ke bilkul upar (dorsal) chalti hai. Aage ja kar yeh phail kar brain ban jati hai.

Post anal tail: tamam chordates mein ek dum (tail) banti hai jo anus se peeche tak jati hai. Kuch chordates isey poori zindagi rakhte hain, jabke doosron mein yeh embryo ki zindagi mein hi khatam ho jati hai.

blocks.alt: Lancelet jaisa chordate, pehlu se: peeth ke saath tubular nerve cord, us ke bilkul neeche poori lambai mein notochord, mouth ke baad pharynx jis mein pharyngeal gill slits hain, gut anus par khatam, aur anus se aage fin wali post-anal tail.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.17: Chordates ki pehchaan wali khasoosiyat (kitab ki Figure 1.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chaaron khasoosiyat dhoondein: (1) peeli tubular nerve cord peeth (dorsal) ki taraf hai aur aage ja kar dimagh banti hai; (2) us ke neeche halka jamni notochord ek lachakdar (semi-rigid) rod hai; (3) laal pharynx mein safed tirchhi lakeerein pharyngeal gill slits hain, yani pharynx ki deewaron mein soorakh; (4) anus (chhota gol soorakh) ke baad jo hissa hai woh post-anal tail hai.
Phylum Chordata mein do bare groups hain: invertebrate chordates (reerh ki haddi ke baghair chordates) aur vertebrates.

items: Subphylum Urochordata mein woh invertebrate chordates aate hain jin mein notochord aur nerve cord sirf aazad tairne wale larvae mein hote hain. Sea squirts urochordates ki misaal hain.
Subphylum Cephalochordata mein woh invertebrate chordates aate hain jin mein notochord poori zindagi rehta hai. Amphioxus ek aam cephalochordate hai.
Vertebrates: in mein vertebral column (reerh ki haddi) aur cranium (khopri) hota hai. Vertebrates saat classes mein baante gaye hain jo do groups mein rakhi gayi hain (agla topic).

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Porifera: tissues nahi; ostia aur osculum; pinacocytes, mesohyle, choanocytes; spicules; gemmules.
Cnidaria: radial, diploblastic; nematocysts wale cnidocytes; sac-like gut; nerve net; polyp aur medusa.
Platyhelminthes: chapte, acoelomate (parenchyma); flame cells; cerebral ganglia; hermaphrodite.
Nematoda: gol, pseudocoelomate; tube-like gut; nerve ring; unisexual; Aschelminths ka numainda phylum.
Mollusca: head, visceral mass aur foot; mantle aur shell; radula; open circulation; nephridia.
Annelida: septa wale metameric segments; setae; metanephridia; haemoglobin ke saath closed circulation.
Arthropoda: jointed appendages, tagmata, chitin ka exoskeleton aur ecdysis; haemolymph; trachea; Malpighian tubules; compound eyes.
Echinodermata: baalig mein paanch ki radial symmetry; ossicles; madreporite aur tube feet wala water-vascular system; regeneration.
Chordata: notochord, pharyngeal slits, dorsal tubular nerve cord, post anal tail; Urochordata, Cephalochordata aur vertebrates.
